overview.startPoint: Speak to Surok by the statue of Saradomin, east of Varrock.

required.note: Items from the tool belt are not listed unless they do not work or are not automatically added.

items.html: Combat equipment to fight a strong level 107 ork who is resistant to range attacks and survive taking multiple hits from different types of monsters.
items.text: Combat equipment to fight a strong level 107 ork who is resistant to range attacks and survive taking multiple hits from different types of monsters.

items.html: An Anti-dragon shield or antifire potion, super energy potions, and antipoisons are useful in the tunnels.
items.text: An Anti-dragon shield or antifire potion, super energy potions, and antipoisons are useful in the tunnels.

items.html: A one-click teleport such as the ectophial or magic tablets.
items.text: A one-click teleport such as the ectophial or magic tablets.

alternatives: A way to restore run energy, such as mint cakes or an Explorer's ring.
The salt-water spring in Oo'glog if you've completed As a First Resort.
The salt-water treatment at the spa pool if you have a tier 1 or higher Spa.
A stamina potion if you have level 77 Herblore.
Have the Endurance relic power activated at the mysterious monolith.

blocks.html: Talk to Surok Magis outside the Tunnel of Chaos, at the Saradomin statue south of Jolly Boar Inn, south of Fort Forinthry. If he's not there, click dig on the statue, then enter and leave.
blocks.text: Talk to Surok Magis outside the Tunnel of Chaos, at the Saradomin statue south of Jolly Boar Inn, south of Fort Forinthry. If he's not there, click dig on the statue, then enter and leave.

blocks.html: After the cutscene, follow him into the tunnel.
blocks.text: After the cutscene, follow him into the tunnel.

blocks.html: Follow him into the portal in the western room (where Dakh'thoulan Aegis is).
blocks.text: Follow him into the portal in the western room (where Dakh'thoulan Aegis is).

Follow Surok through the Chaos Tunnels portals in the route in the above map.
blocks.text: Follow Surok through the Chaos Tunnels portals in the route in the above map.

substeps.html: Be aware that there are aggressive monsters, dragons, and prayer-draining monsters on the way. It is recommended to bring food and combat equipment.
substeps.text: Be aware that there are aggressive monsters, dragons, and prayer-draining monsters on the way. It is recommended to bring food and combat equipment.

substeps.html: You may be randomly teleported by a portal - if so, locate yourself on the map and make your way back to the route.
substeps.text: You may be randomly teleported by a portal - if so, locate yourself on the map and make your way back to the route.

blocks.html: You need to see three cutscenes along the route.

blocks.html: Enter the final portal in the dagannoth room.
blocks.text: Enter the final portal in the dagannoth room.
